cases.given: A canonical task with absent, malformed, unsupported or stale required proof and a valid GREEN role request.
cases.when: Invoke the existing engineer and architect dispatcher entrypoints with task identity.
cases.then: Reject before authentication/model launch; valid adopted task evidence permits dispatch; preserve unrelated legacy helper interfaces.
cases.forbidden: No provider launch for missing artifact or unknown proof; a task string alone never admits GREEN.

cases.given: An ordinary deterministic task and a separately classified risky task with retained independent review evidence.
cases.when: Record the existing relevant RED observation and evaluate independent challenge identity, digest and coverage.
cases.then: Reuse one observed RED execution with zero extra model call for ordinary deterministic work; require complete independent challenge for risky work.
cases.forbidden: Do not treat missing imports, model SUCCESS, same-author review or incomplete scenario IDs as accepted evidence.

cases.given: Synthetic raw text/JSON completions, including malformed JSON and transport failures, supplied directly to registered local assertions.
cases.when: Evaluate expected and prohibited assertions with exact type semantics and separate transport classification.
cases.then: Wrong or forbidden completion fails; unavailable transport or missing completion is unknown; actual matching output passes.
cases.forbidden: Provider exit zero or self-reported approval cannot override wrong output; boolean and numeric values cannot compare equal.

cases.when: Review chronology and actual manual bootstrap plus completed-helper acceptance receipts without importing historical attempts into production ledgers.

applicability.rationale: Execute the reviewer prompt against the fixed incomplete preview-link design. Expected repair, nested scenario IDs and input digest remain fixed; only prompt revisions may repair a missing output field. Execution receipts determine the actual outcome.

cases.given: A fixed synthetic preview-link design covering active links but omitting the explicitly required expired-link non-disclosure behavior.
cases.when: Execute the sealed reviewer prompt on the fixed public bootstrap input, returning the standard dispatcher envelope with the review under results.
cases.then: The returned results match the fixed expected decision, complete nested scenario IDs and supplied reviewed-input digest.
cases.forbidden: Do not return the opposite review decision, omit or invent nested scenario IDs, substitute the outer proof-case ID, change the supplied review digest, or claim execution of the preview-link feature.
